title: Scalus – multiplatform Scala implementation of Cardano Plutus

ms.promise: Scala Compiler Plugin implementation that compiles a subset of Scala 3 to Cardano UPLC.
ms.criteria:
Scala Compiler Plugin implementation that compiles a subset of Scala 3 to Cardano UPLC. 
It provides sensible and friendly error messages.
There are tests that cover all supported Scala features that can be compiled to UPLC.

ms.promise:
Plutus v1/v2 builtins implementation for JVM and JavaScript platforms.
UPLC script evaluation and execution cost calculation implementation for JVM and JavaScript platforms.
ms.criteria:
Plutus v1/v2 builtins implemented according to Plutus specification and work on JVM and JavaScript platforms.
Scalus can perform Script Execution Budget calculation according to PlutusV2 specs.
There are unit and/or property tests that cover that functionality.

ms.report:
Scalus — Milestone 5 Proof of Achievements
Scalus Starter Project
Scalus Starter Project implementation on GitHub:
https://github.com/lantr-io/scalus-starter
The starter project provides a ready-to-use template for developers to quickly start building Cardano smart contracts with Scalus. It includes example smart contracts, build configuration, testing setup, and comprehensive documentation.
Scalus Demeter.run Template
Scalus Demeter.run template implementation on GitHub:
https://github.com/txpipe/awesome-starter-kits/pull/64
The Demeter.run template has been fully implemented and submitted to the txpipe/awesome-starter-kits repository. The PR has been open for 3 months awaiting merge by the Demeter.run platform maintainers. The template is complete and ready for use.
Documentation, Examples, Tutorials Published on Scalus.org
Documentation website: https://scalus.org
API documentation: https://scalus.org/api/index.html
GitHub repository with extensive examples and README: https://github.com/nau/scalus
Example smart contracts and usage:
・HTLC Validator: https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.13.0/scalus-examples/jvm/src/main/scala/scalus/examples/htlc/HtlcValidator.scala
・Vault Contract: https://github.com/nau/scalus/blob/v0.13.0/scalus-examples/jvm/src/main/scala/scalus/examples/vault/VaultValidator.scala
・AdaStream Project: https://github.com/nau/adastream

The website includes getting started guides, tutorials, API reference, and multiple real-world smart contract examples demonstrating Scalus usage across JVM, JavaScript, and Native platforms.
